abilities.name: Names of Power
abilities.narrationHints: They do not stare or strain. They say a name quietly, the way you would call someone across a yard, and the person turns whether or not they wanted to.
abilities.description: Hold a person by the names they answer to — and the more of them you have, the less of them is left to refuse you.
abilities.notFor: Anyone whose names you have not honestly learned; crowds; anything that does not have a name for itself.

intensity.conserve: one word, one moment of obedience
intensity.surge: the full name, and hold it; ⛔ WHAT YOU COMPEL THIS WAY REMEMBERS BEING COMPELLED — you have not made an obedient thing, you have made an enemy who will take the first chance it gets

crit.success: They answer to a name you did not know you had — and so does something else in earshot.

failure.text: You speak a name that is nearly theirs. They hear the miss, and now they know what you were reaching for.

bounds.text: ⛔ EACH NAME MUST HAVE BEEN LEARNED HONESTLY. Guessing fails and a wrong name warns them
one target, in sight and in earshot
⚠️ they know it was done and by whom — this is never deniable
a mind with no name for itself cannot be held this way

abilities.plainly: A social/duel action that binds a target. Its strength is rated 7 out of 10.
abilities.theNames: ⚠️ A person has three: the name they are CALLED (public, cheap to learn), the name they are KNOWN BY (a byname — what the world says), and the name they CALL THEMSELVES, which almost nobody gives away.

tree.name: Name They Are Called
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE NAME. Speak it and they must stop, turn, or answer — one compelled act, briefly, and nothing that harms them or theirs.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ A public name compels only a public act. They know exactly what happened and who did it.

tree.name: Name They Are Known By
tree.grants: ⚠️ TWO NAMES. Sustained control while you hold attention on them — they walk, speak, hand over, stand down.
tree.cannot: You must hold attention; doing anything else releases them. They can still refuse an act that would end them.
tree._nameWas: The Name They Are Known By

tree.name: Name They Call Themselves
tree.grants: ⛔ ALL THREE NAMES. The hold no longer needs your attention and no longer ends when you look away — it runs for a day, and they carry it with them out of the room. ⚠️ They will do what they would never do, and remember agreeing to it.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ Almost nobody gives this name away — getting it is a campaign, not a roll. One person at a time, and it is the kind of act a person does not come back from being.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ ALL THREE. No part of them is left outside the hold. They will do what they would never do, and remember agreeing to it.
tree._rebalance: ⛔ MY OWN CAPSTONE'S FINAL RANK GAINED NOTHING. 'No part of them left outside the hold' is qualitative. It now buys AUTONOMY — the hold runs without you — which is the one thing r2 explicitly could not do.
tree._harmRungWas: ⛔ 'severe' is not a rung. -> incapacitating: compulsion carried for a day — control, not injury (Aevi 2026-08-23)

abilities._replaces: ⛔ SNG-453: replaces The True Name (L5, e14, ONE rank, no roll, 'a hold on its very being' — meaning nothing mechanically). Erik: 'A Mind capstone should include DOMINATION. It would rank up and be more effective the more of the target's true names.' ⚠️ Ranks are NAMES HELD, not power tiers, so gathering names becomes play — and the bynames authored in SNG-430 are now weapons.

Erik: 'label them how you need to, as long as you know how to correct them at the end.' ⛔ AT MIGRATION: swap tradition ← traditionV2 and drop this field.

abilities._diceStrip:
⛔ SNG-471, CCODE Q1: `mechanic.dice` IS consumed — craftmechanics.mechanicFor → rollMagnitude → skill_battle.js:798 — ⚠️ BUT THE GUARD IS `shape === 'damage'`, and only `damage` and `strike` resolve to it. `hobble` and `hinder` DO NOT.
⛔ SO THIS CRAFT AUTHORED 4d6 THAT NOTHING WOULD EVER ROLL. Erik's shape is right — a hold is not damage — so the DICE GO, not the shape. ⚠️ CCode: 'I would not widen the guard silently — "this craft does 4d6 of hold" is a different claim about the world.' AGREED.
abilities._persuadeRemoved_20260829: ⛔ `persuade` REMOVED — the third verb-in-the-wrong-slot after `bolster` on `wellspring` and this craft's own shape mismatch. ⚠️ THE LADDER SETTLES IT: r1 'they MUST stop, turn, or answer' · r2 'SUSTAINED CONTROL' · r3 'the hold no longer needs your attention'. THAT IS COMPULSION — `bind` and `command`, both already declared. ⛔ AND THE VOCABULARY IS EXPLICIT: persuade means 'bring someone to AGREE — they act because they now think it right', and is 'NOT `command`, which does not need agreement'. NOBODY AGREES TO ANYTHING IN THIS CRAFT. ⚠️ r3 ALREADY DROPPED `persuade` ON ITS OWN, which is the craft saying so. ⛔ ALSO: ability rung was `damaging` while r3 reaches `incapacitating` — a craft that binds and never wounds was glossed to the GM as one that hurts.
abilities._intensityAuthored_20260829: ⚠️ WAS THE BARE STRING 'severe' — a HARM WORD in the intensity field, from an older schema where `intensity` meant severity. ⛔ The engine reads a conserve/surge PAIR (`engine/intensity.js`), so a string meant this craft had NO conserve and NO surge and silently resolved at standard only. Authored as a real pair: conserve gives up scope for cost, surge takes something from the wielder.
abilities._surgeFix_20260829: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: my surge said 'what answers a true name may not be only them', which is WRONG — IT IS ONLY THEM. ⚠️ The real cost is relational: 'when you control something like that you kindle it against you, and it would likely look to have its revenge if it gets the chance.' ⛔ That is better because it is a CONSEQUENCE THE CRAFT EARNS rather than a spooky ambiguity I invented — compulsion makes enemies, and this craft compels absolutely.

abilities.name: Mind Meld
abilities.narrationHints: Two people stop finishing each other's sentences because they have stopped needing sentences. It is intimate in a way that embarrasses both of them afterwards.
abilities.description: Open your mind to another and hold it open — see what they see, know what they know, and act as one thing across a distance neither of you could shout across.
abilities.notFor: An unwilling mind; anyone who was not in sight when it opened; hiding what you feel from the people you are linked to.

intensity.conserve: a shallow join — thoughts, not selves
intensity.surge: go all the way in; ⚠️ SOME OF WHAT YOU BRING BACK WILL NOT BE YOURS

crit.success: For a moment the whole party thinks with one mind and moves like it.

failure.text: One of them is holding something you were not ready for, and now you are both holding it.

bounds.text: ⛔ WILLING ONLY, and each must have been in sight when the link opened
surface thought and senses — not memory, not what they are hiding
⚠️ YOU FEEL WHAT THEY FEEL, INCLUDING DYING
what one of them believes, all of them believe while it holds

abilities.plainly: An investigate/survive action that links willing minds. Its strength is rated 7 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 extends to distance and several people; rank 3 shares what each one knows.

tree.name: Open Door
tree.grants: ⛔ ONE WILLING PERSON IN SIGHT. Share senses and surface thought both ways — coordination without signals, acting on the same instant.
tree.cannot: Willing only, and in sight. Surface thought — not memory, not what they are hiding.

tree.name: Long Room
tree.grants: ⛔ LINK WILLING MINDS ACROSS MILES AND WITH SEVERAL AT ONCE. Shared senses and surface thought — ⛔ A SCOUT WHO REPORTS WITHOUT COMING BACK; a party split across a building acting as one.
tree.cannot: All must be willing and must have been in sight when it opened. You feel what they feel, including dying.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS DISTANCE AND NUMBER. Hold it across miles and with several at once — ⛔ A SCOUT WHO REPORTS WITHOUT COMING BACK; a party split across a building acting as one.

tree.name: One Mind
tree.grants: ⛔ EVERYONE LINKED CAN USE WHAT ANY ONE OF THEM KNOWS — the linguist's language, the mason's eye for a load. And the link survives one of you being unconscious, panicking, or under a working meant to break it.
tree.cannot: Knowledge, never craft: you cannot use their tradition's power. What one believes, all believe while it holds.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ ADDS CAPABILITY-SHARING. Everyone linked can use what any one of them KNOWS — the linguist's language, the mason's eye for a load, the fighter's read of a stance.
tree._rebalance: ⚠️ Was scope, its third. Quality + conditions makes the capstone rank about RELIABILITY, which is what a party actually needs from a link.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS CAPABILITY-SHARING. Everyone linked can use what any one of them KNOWS — and the link now survives one of you being unconscious, panicking, or under a working meant to break it.

abilities._senseNote:
⛔ SNG-470: USABLE IN THE SENSE SLOT. ⚠️ reads through an ALLY — the shared sense
⚠️ Erik: 'you're not quite right about the sense abilities — they're probably listed as REVEAL. Check again.' ⛔ HE WAS RIGHT: 56 crafts carry reveal/foresee/track and EVERY tradition has one. My 'only 3 sense crafts' was counting the tag I had hand-applied, not the corpus. ⚠️ THE FILTER IS WHETHER IT READS A LIVE OPPONENT IN THE MOMENT — terrain, objects, history and the dead do not qualify.

abilities.name: Named Exclusion
abilities.narrationHints: A line drawn once, in chalk or salt or a scratched groove, and then a thing arrives at it and stops as though it had hit a wall it can see and you cannot.
abilities.description: Set a figure on a place and name what it keeps out — a threshold one named kind of thing cannot cross, and it holds without you standing there.
abilities.notFor: Things you cannot name precisely; anything already inside when you set it; a place you cannot mark.

crit.success: The mark takes deeper than you set it and holds against things you did not name.
crit.failure: You name the category imprecisely. Something you meant to keep in is out.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU MUST NAME THE CATEGORY EXACTLY. 'Harm' does nothing; 'anyone carrying steel' works
what is already inside stays inside
the figure must be marked on something that stays put
⚠️ a named exclusion tells anyone who reads it exactly what you are afraid of

abilities.plainly: A survive/fight action that wards a place against a named category. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 holds unattended, rank 3 governs a whole site.

tree.name: Set Mark
tree.grants: ⛔ A THRESHOLD ONE NAMED KIND OF THING CANNOT CROSS — a person, an intent, a working, a category of creature. A door, a circle, a line across a road.
tree.cannot: One category, one threshold, and it lasts while you are within a short walk of it.

tree.name: Mark That Keeps
tree.grants: ⛔ SET A THRESHOLD A NAMED CATEGORY CANNOT CROSS, AND IT HOLDS WITHOUT YOU. No attention or presence needed, and it covers a room, a camp or a compound rather than a doorway.
tree.cannot: You must return to renew it before the season turns; a determined breaker can still break the mark itself.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS INDEPENDENCE AND SIZE. It holds without your attention or presence, and covers a room, a camp or a compound rather than a doorway.

tree.name: Governed Ground
tree.grants: ⛔ SET A FIGURE A WHOLE SITE OBEYS — water runs where it says, sound carries where it says, a named thing does not cross anywhere within it — AND a concrete thing within it is bound to match the pattern you set for as long as it holds.
tree.cannot: One site, and setting it takes a day. A figure this large is visible to anyone who reads figures.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS RULE AND COMPULSION. A figure a whole site obeys — water runs where it says, sound carries where it says, a named thing does not cross anywhere within it — AND a concrete thing within it is bound to match the pattern you set for as long as the figure holds.

abilities._powerSystemFix:
⛔ SNG-533. I AUTHORED THIS `metaphysical` ON INSTINCT because the craft 'felt' psychic. ⛔ FIGURIST IS `wild_nanite` — ERIK, 2026-08-15: 'Figurist is ABSTRACT — think art, or math. Abstract is more of a crazy impression, like a WILD DREAM.'
⚠️ COGITANT IS metaphysical AND I APPLIED IT TO ALL THREE MIND SECTS — the tradition merge made them one people in my head and canon keeps them three. ⛔ FOUND BY WRITING A CHECK THAT ASSERTS WHICH SOURCE rather than whether one, which is the thing CCode's §C3 does and none of mine did.

abilities.name: Unbroken Thread
abilities.narrationHints: Everyone else has stopped being useful hours ago. They are still going, at the same pace, and they pick the sentence back up exactly where it was interrupted.
abilities.description: Keep working — a thought, a watch, a translation, a wound being tended — through fear, pain, exhaustion and interruption, and come back to exactly where you were.
abilities.notFor: Physical endurance (this holds the mind, not the body); anything requiring rest; making you faster.

bounds.text: holds the MIND, not the body — you still starve, still bleed, still need to sleep eventually
one line of work at a time
⚠️ the fatigue is deferred, not cancelled, and it arrives all at once when you stop

abilities.plainly: A survive/investigate action that sustains mental work. Its strength is rated 4 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 extends to days, rank 3 to conditions that break other people.

tree.name: Held Through
tree.grants: Hold a complex train of thought through interruption, fear, pain or noise — and return to exactly where you were, not approximately.
tree.cannot: One line of work. An interruption that lasts days still ends it.

tree.name: Across Days
tree.grants: ⛔ SUSTAIN COMPLEX MENTAL WORK ACROSS DAYS without the thinking degrading — a problem, a plan, a translation, a vigil — and return to exactly where you were after any interruption.
tree.cannot: You must still eat and sleep, though less well than you should.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS DURATION. Sustain complex work across days without the thinking degrading — a problem, a plan, a translation, a vigil.

tree.name: Last Thing to Fail
tree.grants: ⛔ FUNCTION CLEARLY WHERE BETTER BODIES HAVE STOPPED — cold, blood loss, three days without water, a burning building. The work continues and its quality does not fall.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ The body still fails on schedule. This only means you are thinking clearly while it does.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS CONDITIONS. Function clearly where better bodies have stopped — cold, blood loss, three days without water, a burning building.

abilities._merged: ⛔ SNG-453: MERGES The Axiom Holds (syllogist, L1, e1) and The Long Form (cogitant, L2, e1) — both 'keep functioning under pressure through mental discipline', same arc: hold → hold for days → you are the last thing to fail. Flavour internal.

sectFlavour.syllogist: THE AXIOM HOLDS — fear and doubt operate below the level of what you know to be true.
sectFlavour.cogitant: THE LONG FORM — the thought is simply not put down.
sectFlavour.figurist: THE KEPT PATTERN — you hold the shape of the work and the work keeps its shape.

abilities._challengeTypesNormalised_20260824: ⛔ I INTRODUCED NON-CANONICAL TYPES DURING THE DEATH WALKTHROUGH AND THE LINT CAUGHT ME. The canonical set is FIGHT · SOCIAL · INVESTIGATE · PUZZLE · SURVIVE · EXPLORE · STEALTH · CHASE · DUEL · TRAVEL · CREATE · DEFEND. ⚠️ I authored INVESTIGATION, ENDURANCE, INTELLECTUAL, HARDSHIP and COMBAT — plausible English, not the vocabulary. Seven of the eight crafts carrying them were mine, from this session. Normalised ['SURVIVE', 'INVESTIGATE', 'ENDURE'] -> ['SURVIVE', 'INVESTIGATE'].

_gainAxes: ⛔ SNG-468: `gainAxes` derived per rank from the rank's own text. ⚠️ MY MATRIX HAD BEEN READING UNPOPULATED RANKS AS 'ADDS NOTHING' — Erik caught it on Borrowed Form, whose ranks are an hour / a day plus a passenger / the whole party. THE SKILL WAS FINE; THE INSTRUMENT WAS BROKEN.
_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
